title: Marcos: South China Sea code '85 to 90%' complete
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said negotiations for the South China Sea code of conduct has reached "85% to 90%" completion at the close of Manila's year as chair of ASEAN — a higher progress…

blocks.text: e Presidential Communications Office (PCO), through its Freedom of Information Program Management Office (FOI-PMO), formally opened the 14th Edition of the International Conference of Information Commissioners (ICIC) on 19 June 2023 at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC).

MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said negotiations for the South China Sea code of conduct has reached "85% to 90%" completion at the close of Manila's year as chair of ASEAN — a higher progress estimate than what was initially announced by his government.

Marcos said while Manila would have wanted the code to be finished during its chairship, "we can take solace in the fact that the majority of the issues, actually the issues are already done and decided and agreed upon."
"I asked our negotiators [and the] special envoy, in her view, how much of it has actually been completed, and she said 85 to 90 percent of it has actually been done," the president said.
